Imaan waalo! Khabardaar mere aur apne dushmanon ko dost mat banaana ke tum un ki taraf dosti ki pesh-kash karo, jab ke unhon ne us haq ka inkaar kar diya hai jo tumhaare paas aa chuka hai, aur woh Rasool ko aur tum ko sirf is baat par nikaal rahe hain ke tum apne Parwardigar (Allah) par imaan rakhte ho. Agar tum waaqai hamaari raah mein jihaad aur hamaari marzi ki talaash mein ghar se nikle ho to un se khufiya dosti kis tarah kar rahe ho, jab ke main tumhaare zaahir o baatin sab ko jaanta hoon, aur jo bhi tum mein se aisa iqdaam karega woh yaqeenan seedhe raaste se behak gaya hai
Yeh agar tumhein pa jaayenge to tumhaare dushman saabit honge, aur tumhaari taraf buraai ke iraade se haath aur zabaan se iqdaam karenge, aur yeh chaahenge ke tum bhi kaafir ho jaao
Yaqeenan tumhaare qaraabat-daar aur tumhaari aulaad roz-e-qiyaamat kaam aane waali nahin hai. Us din Khuda tumhaare darmiyaan faisla kar dega, aur woh tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Tumhaare liye behtareen namoona-e-amal Ibraheem alaihis-salaam aur un ke saathiyon mein hai, jab unhon ne apni qaum se keh diya ke hum tum se aur tumhaare ma'boodon se bezaar hain. Hum ne tumhaara inkaar kar diya hai aur hamaare tumhaare darmiyaan bughz aur adaawat bilkul waazeh hai, yahaan tak ke tum Khuda-e-Wahdahu La Shareek par imaan le aao, ilaawa Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ke us qaul ke jo unhon ne apne murabbi baap se keh diya tha ke main tumhaare liye istighfaar zaroor karoonga lekin main Parwardigar ki taraf se koi ikhtiyaar nahin rakhta hoon. Khudaaya! Main ne tere oopar bharosa kiya hai aur teri hi taraf rujoo kiya hai aur teri hi taraf baazgasht bhi hai
Khudaaya! Mujhe kuffaar ke liye fitna o bala na qaraar dena aur mujhe bakhsh dena ke tu hi saahib-e-izzat aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Beshak tumhaare liye un logon mein behtareen namoona-e-amal hai, us shakhs ke liye jo Allah aur roz-e-aakhirat ka umeedwaar hai, aur jo inhiraaf karega Khuda us se be-niyaaz aur qaabil-e-hamd o sana hai
Qareeb hai ke Khuda tumhaare aur jin se tum ne dushmani ki hai un ke darmiyaan dosti qaraar de de, ke woh saahib-e-qudrat hai aur bahut bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Woh tumhein un logon ke baare mein jinhon ne tum se deen ke mu'aamle mein jang nahin ki hai aur tumhein watan se nahin nikaala hai, is baat se nahin rokta hai ke tum un ke saath neki aur insaaf karo, ke Khuda insaaf karne waalon ko dost rakhta hai

Woh tumhein sirf un logon se rokta hai jinhon ne tum se deen mein jang ki hai aur tumhein watan se nikaal baahar kiya hai aur tumhaare nikaalne par dushmanon ki madad ki hai, ke un se dosti karo, aur jo un se dosti karega woh yaqeenan zaalim hoga

Imaan waalo! Jab tumhaare paas hijrat karne waali momin auratein aayein to pehle un ka imtehaan karo, ke Allah un ke imaan ko khoob jaanta hai. Phir agar tum bhi dekho ke yeh momina hain to khabardaar inhein kuffaar ki taraf waapas na karna. Na woh un ke liye halaal hain aur na yeh un ke liye halaal hain, aur jo kharcha kuffaar ne mahr ka diya hai woh inhein waapas kar do, aur tumhaare liye koi harj nahin hai ke tum un ki ujrat (mahr) dene ke baad un se nikaah kar lo. Aur khabardaar kaafir auraton ki ismat pakad kar na rakho, aur jo tum ne kharch kiya hai woh kuffaar se le lo aur jo unhon ne kharch kiya hai woh tum se le lein, ke yahi hukm-e-Khuda hai jis ka faisla Khuda ne tumhaare darmiyaan kiya hai, aur woh bada saahib-e-ilm o hikmat hai

Aur agar tumhaari koi biwi kuffaar ki taraf chali jaaye aur phir tum un ko saza do to jin ki biwi chali gayi hai un ka kharch maal-e-ghaneemat mein se de do, aur us Allah se bahar-haal darte raho jis par imaan rakhne waale ho

Paighambar! Agar imaan laane waali auratein aap ke paas is amr par bai'at karne ke liye aayein ke kisi ko Khuda ka shareek nahin banaayengi aur chori nahin karengi, zina nahin karengi, aulaad ko qatl nahin karengi aur apne haath paaon ke saamne se koi bohtaan (ladka) le kar nahin aayengi aur kisi neki mein aap ki mukhaalifat nahin karengi, to aap un se bai'at ka mu'aamla kar lein aur un ke haq mein istighfaar karein ke Khuda bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Imaan waalo! Khabardaar us qaum se hargiz dosti na karna jis par Khuda ne ghazab naazil kiya hai, ke woh aakhirat se usi tarah maayoos honge jis tarah kuffaar qabr waalon se maayoos ho jaate hain
